title: A Tale of Pronouns: Interpretability Informs Gender Bias Mitigation for Fairer Instruction-Tuned Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance using the WinoMT benchmark to measure differences in accuracy between male and female pronoun referents, as well as between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical gender-occupation assignments. The study also uses interpretability methods (Integrated Gradients) to analyze token attribution scores and determine how much the models rely on gender pronouns versus defaulting to male inflections.
